territories.name: Barbados
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Barbados levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act, Cap. 87, administered by the Barbados Revenue Authority: section 7 imposes it on the taxable supply in Barbados of goods or services by a registrant and on goods imported into Barbados, with a standard rate, a lower rate for accommodation, a zero rate for the supplies of the First Schedule and exemption for those of the Second.
